presets.name: Simple depth → power
presets.description: Start here: any contact's depth drives power on both channels

presets.name: Depth + LFO frequency
presets.description: Depth sets power while a slow sine sweeps the pulse rate

presets.name: Speed-driven intensity with smoothing
presets.description: UKF speed, smoothed, shapes the intensity; depth sets power

presets.name: Two-zone blend A/B
presets.description: Crossfade socket and plug contacts on A, strongest of both on B

presets.name: Two devices from one contact
presets.description: One contact drives Device 1 directly and Device 2 through an ease-in curve

presets.name: Guarded soft start
presets.description: A soft-start group, a deadman and a panic node between the contact and the device

presets.name: Heartbeat while touched
presets.description: A sequenced thump-thump that only beats while the contact is held

presets.name: Four-segment texture
presets.description: Frequency and intensity split into four 25 ms segments, one swept by an LFO

presets.name: Tease timer
presets.description: The longer the contact is held, the stronger it gets

presets.name: Echo tail (feedback)
presets.description: Feedback through a Delay leaves a fading echo after every touch

presets.name: Breathing noise
presets.description: Slow noise makes pulse rate and intensity drift on their own

presets.name: Ping-pong A/B
presets.description: A triangle LFO pans the contact between channel A and channel B

presets.name: Classic functions on a clock
presets.description: Any Classic modulation function, driven by time, shapes frequency and intensity

presets.name: Faster strokes, faster pulses
presets.description: Stroke speed sets the pulse rate; depth sets the power

presets.name: Touch envelope (ADSR)
presets.description: Touch starts an envelope that swells, settles and fades after release

presets.name: Pull-out spike
presets.description: A fast pull-out fires a short burst on top of half-strength depth

presets.name: Avatar slider sets the max
presets.description: An avatar float parameter sets Limit Max live — never above the Graph cap

presets.name: Hotkey pattern switch
presets.description: F3 flips between a smooth and a choppy pattern; hold F4 for a manual burst

presets.name: Four-voice drift
presets.description: Long-form: eight slow voices on every segment of both channels, hours before it repeats

presets.name: Slow escalation
presets.description: Long-form: a ten-minute climb — the ceiling and the floor rise while a melody plays as a canon

presets.name: Breathing cathedral
presets.description: Long-form: a 20 s breath opens one channel's ceiling as it closes the other's, over polyrhythmic bells

presets.name: Drifting polyrhythm
presets.description: Long-form: four clocks at 3·4·5·7 per four seconds, slightly detuned, one per intensity segment

presets.name: Depth moves the ceiling
presets.description: Long-form: touch opens the power, depth sets the ceiling, and intensity orbits all eight segments

presets.name: Glitch rain
presets.description: Long-form: random stepped pitch and intensity per segment, with a floor that jumps every 5 s

presets.name: High buzz, rolling intensity
presets.description: High frequency: 85–100 Hz on every segment while four waves roll the intensity, faster with speed

presets.name: Hummingbird
presets.description: High frequency: 95–100 Hz chopped 5–14 times a second by velocity, A and B in turn

presets.name: Nightmare · no safe rhythm
presets.description: Nightmare: random bursts of random pitch, low thumps in between, pull-outs punish with a full burst

presets.name: Nightmare · ratchet
presets.description: Nightmare: every pull-out ratchets the floor and ceiling up; it only lets go after 3 s untouched

presets.name: Low thump
presets.description: Low frequency: 3–12 Hz thumps that slow down the deeper you go, B a softer echo

presets.name: Deep rumble
presets.description: Low frequency: 1–6 Hz, a slow wandering rumble that quickens with velocity

presets.name: Mid-range roll
presets.description: Mid frequency: four segments roll through 25–50 Hz; velocity brings the intensity up

presets.name: Low–mid wander
presets.description: Low to mid frequency: 6–40 Hz wandering in opposite directions on A and B; velocity widens the range

presets.name: Feather
presets.description: Soft: a gentle 55–75 Hz touch that fades in over a second and out over 2.5 s, capped at 10

presets.name: Warm tide
presets.description: Soft: a slow 10 s tide of power flowing from A to B over a gently rolling 30–45 Hz, capped at 14

presets.name: Freefall
presets.description: Algorithmic: high pulses fall away abruptly by a chaotic amount on a motion-driven clock — never the same twice

presets.name: Undertow
presets.description: Algorithmic: turbulence crossing a moving threshold drops the pulse rate onto random rungs; it climbs back at the speed of your motion

presets.name: Fault line
presets.description: Algorithmic: motion loads stress until it slips — the pulse rate shatters downward across all four segments, each climbing back at its own speed

presets.name: UKF speed tap
presets.description: Contact → UKF → smoothed speed, with a scope — wire it in

presets.name: Stale-safe OSC input
presets.description: An avatar parameter, smoothed, that drops to 0 when VRChat stops sending it

presets.name: Soft-start group
presets.description: A ramp limiter and a hard limit, grouped — reusable
